status: Interactive visual proposal for author review; no production deployment
runtime: HTML presentation using scenes.json hosts, stable native buttons, generated frame and picture layers
data: getReviewSession from ../shared/practice-journey.ts; one top-window in-memory session. No live saves or database.

1.purpose: Picture-led introduction; concrete target selection opens the catacombs. Training stays available after mastery.

2.purpose: Independent mode confirmation per player; remembered targets come from the shared session. Solo uses the selected owner.
2.contract: Do boje emits preview:battle-ready with players[{owner,mode,targetId}] and opens MathBoard preview without creating a battle receipt.

4.purpose: Render the actual per-owner receipt, module median before/after, awarded coins/mana, and the shared journey lock. Null receipt is empty.
4.contract: Journey navigation retains receipt.targetId and owner. Personal bonus percentage is not presented as a change of module medians.

5.purpose: Rescue at catalog strength followed by Pythia; actual upgrades before/after; current ownership and two real trial marks.
5.contract: Read session.trial(owner) and snapshot. Every action is navigation, never a reward or binding mutation.

layout: All static hosts are in scenes.json. Production Phaser integration must read the corresponding positions and depths through SceneBuilder. Preserve actual bitmap aspect ratios and safe insets.
animations: Fixed hit targets with shared surface lift/press; selection glow; measured time-bar transition; strength highlight. No invented rune transfer or creature motion.
art: prompts.json records every built-in image_gen prompt and original source. Final workspace assets are under assets/. assets/normalization.json records shared state transforms.
validation: review/journey-verification.json and review/journey-visual-review.json supersede the earlier standalone fixture report. No migration required.
limits: Proposal only. Current runtime rules over synthetic profiles; higher speed tiers and new economy await approval. Training after mastery is available in the proposal but its production bonus is not implemented. Touch emulation is not a child or physical-tablet playtest.
embedding: embedded=1 hides review chrome. Include owner and targetId in first URL. Call flowPreview.route after flowPreview.ready or flow-preview-ready; session subscription handles later routes.
